regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing-but-still-broad leadership structure: AI Infrastructure leads by momentum rank, with US Energy Complex a close challenger and a wide eligible set (22/49). The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control (gate_helps=true), while cross-sectional rank-IC is ~zero and rotation timing is display-only, so no return forecasting is being claimed; the one falsifiable discipline edge here is trend-gate survival.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the AI Infrastructure -> US Energy Complex margin continues to narrow from 0.185: a confirmed handoff (Energy Complex overtaking AI Infrastructure on the momentum rank while both remain trend-gate eligible) would retire the watch and shift the lean toward Energy-led leadership.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure holds the top momentum rank and is trend-gate eligible, but its durability_bar (0.50) is the lowest of the leading themes, breadth (0.125) is narrow, hurst_tag is mixed, and its r10 is slightly negative — leadership is concentrated rather than broad. The absolute-trend gate is the only validated leg, so the lean is a de-risked continuation, not a momentum chase.
evidence: rank 1, score 1.56 (focus lens only, not alpha)
theses.dissent: Narrow breadth plus a mixed Hurst tag means the rank is driven by a few mega-caps; if those reverse, the theme unwinds fast without the durability support seen in Energy or Health Care.

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is the confirmed challenger immediately behind AI Infrastructure with the broadest cohort support in the top group (breadth 0.636 vs 0.125 for the leader) and a higher durability_bar (0.62). It is trend-gate eligible and not crowded, which combines the validated staying-power leg with better participation than the rank leader.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is reflexive to macro/policy headlines; if the AI-infrastructure narrative re-accelerates, breadth in Energy can evaporate quickly and momentum may stall without a confirmed handoff.

falsifier.text: XLE lags XLB by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is trend-gate eligible, has a trend Hurst tag and a high durability_bar (0.75), but is the most crowded theme in the leading group (crowding_z 1.61, crowded=true). Crowding is a size-down caution only, not a fade; the lean is a risk-controlled continuation with crowding as the reason to keep expression modest.
theses.dissent: Elevated crowding with a top-quartile crowding_z marks attention concentration; if the AI-infrastructure leadership persists, crowded players may face sharper mean-reversion on any shake-out.

falsifier.text: CIBR underperforms SPY by 8% before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
